notes.title: 1.1.0｜update
notes.content: [p]We have added new features to make the game more accessible for many players.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Update Details[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The "Choose Control" screen at the start of the game has been changed to "Select Mode"[/p][/*][*][p]An "Easy Mode" with available checkpoints has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A new achievement, "Spacetime Journey" has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor adjustments have been made.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Checkpoints[/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163087/cc0214a9fbaa8becdaba687783eb655133b611e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When you start in Easy Mode, an additional orange wormhole will appear.[/p][p]If you fall, you will automatically pass through the wormhole and return to the checkpoint.[/p]

notes.title: Rolling Macho – Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163087/f55aab6a426bcd42e40e7ba65d79c96df203a83d.png[/img]

Rolling Macho – Available Now on Steam!
The Game Where a Macho Man Cartwheels and Squats His Way Back to Earth.

There's no time to wonder why a macho man is in space or why he's cartwheeling.
All you need to understand is that he's in space and must return to Earth.

The only way is up! All you need is the physical strength to keep rolling and the determination to never give up.
